486:t_015:9.en:
$$ジン$$
「It's impossible... You can't just gather 12,000 years' worth of feelings...」

486:t_015:12.en:
$$不動$$
「You yourselves have passed through 12,000 years and are about to advance to a new stage.」

486:t_015:23.en:
$$不動$$
「Now is the time to show it.」

486:t_015:24.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「But even that cannot drive away the darkness.」

486:t_015:25.en:
$$ズール$$
「The stronger the light, the deeper the darkness becomes.」

486:t_015:26.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Love and hatred are two sides of the same coin...」

486:t_015:27.en:
$n
「It's just like... the $$いがみ合う双子$$...」

486:t_015:29.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Please don't make it sound like twins never get along!」

486:t_015:32.en:
$$タケル$$
「Light and darkness... They're just like twins...」

486:t_016:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Let's do it, everyone! We'll unite all our feelings and gather them in $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$!」

486:t_016:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Hope, courage, love, justice... Humanity's positive emotions...」

486:t_016:2.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Those should become a light that drives away this darkness!」

486:t_017:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「Light doesn't erase darkness... Beyond light and darkness...」

486:t_017:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Just watch, $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$! We'll show you humanity's light as it drives away the darkness!」

486:t_017:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Uoooooh! Answer me, $$アクエリオン$$!!」

486:t_018:1.en:
$$タケル$$
(We have loving hearts to overcome hatred... Hope is born because we face despair...)

486:t_018:2.en:
$$タケル$$
(Light and darkness are both part of the human heart... We cannot be human with only one of them...)

486:t_018:3.en:
$$タケル$$
(So we mustn't reject darkness. We have to accept it.)

486:t_019:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Was the person with him his brother, $$マーグ$$...?!」

486:t_019:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「You all felt my brother, too.」

486:t_019:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「And now I know what we have to do.」

486:t_019:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Heh... I was so busy beating up villains, I never thought about what darkness meant.」

486:t_019:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I remember! We should already have learned this!」

486:t_019:9.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Death is nothing to fear.」

486:t_019:10.en:
$$カイエン$$
「That's right... If this is the world of death, the souls of our loved ones might be here, too.」

486:t_019:17.en:
$$タケル$$
「We are who we are today because of them...」

486:t_019:18.en:
$$タケル$$
「We'll accept darkness and make it our strength, too!」

486:t_020:1.en:
$$カヲル$$
「The world's balance has been preserved, so they have returned to where they belong.」

486:t_020:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「What is this feeling...?! I've never felt it before, yet it's somehow familiar!」

486:t_020:3.en:
$$葵$$
「Power is welling up inside me, even in this dark, cold place...!」

486:t_020:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「Because we know darkness, we can feel the light all the more...」

486:t_020:5.en:
$$不動$$
「Where there is light, there is darkness... Where there is darkness, there is light...」

486:t_020:6.en:
$$不動$$
「Knowing yin lets us understand yang. That is the yang of the $$太極$$... The sun itself!」

486:t_020:10.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ズール$$! Now I'll show you the true power you feared! My power... Our power!」

486:t_021:0.en:
$$ズール$$
「$$マーズ$$! I can feel $$マーグ$$ within you!」

486:t_022:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$正太郎$$! Get $$鉄人$$ back while you can!」

486:t_022:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s malice is interfering with it. Then your feelings should be able to move $$鉄人$$, too.」

486:t_022:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「Remember. When we defeated $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, $$鉄人$$ came back to you even though you weren't using the $$Ｖコン$$.」

486:t_022:6.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「I will not allow it! $$鉄人$$, obey my will!」

486:t_023:2.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「$$鉄人$$! You, too, shall become part of my forces!」
